NCT07675746.eligibilityExcerpt: Inclusion Criteria: 1. Patients aged 2-18 years with Dravet syndrome caused by SCN1A mutations, with onset before 12 months of age characterized by focal seizures, hemiclonic seizures, generalized tonic-clonic seizures, or myoclonic seizures, and with MRI excluding progressive neurological disease either historically or at screening.
